question: Does an uninstrumented full-cache query specialization preserve matched complete recoveries and change descriptive cold/query cost on the original RTX4090 workloads?

claims.text: Every reported recovery is independently replayed from a serialized certificate and corrupted-scalar certificates are rejected.
Shared-host per-row times and baseline-repeat spread describe the fixed workloads; no population inference or certified timing advantage.

arms.description: Unchanged generic persistent affine full-cache queries

positive.not_applicable_reason: All successful public-input recoveries must satisfy scalar multiplication and complete independent certificate replay; existing tiny known-answer reduction controls run first.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Each successful certificate is copied with scalar incremented modulo r; a fresh verifier must reject with exit1, not timeout. Invalid curves/order witnesses are tested before measurement.

factors.name: source_and_build
factors.how: One frozen source and flags; only ER_QUERY_FULL_CACHE differs. Identical arithmetic, driver, cache, index, filter and budgets. Baseline generic kernel source unchanged. All setup charged.

factors.name: inputs
factors.value: Exact original63-bit fixture and seed202 target, unchanged row/work limits; no target scalar.
factors.how: No target scalar is generated or supplied. Curve order is checked with prime torsion witness and unique Hasse multiple before solving.

factors.name: host
factors.how: All three new rows on one fresh full RTX4090 and pod. Device state, affinity and CPUinfo recorded; L0 only. Prior host rows never pooled or substituted.

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.how: Fresh-process ASLR; identical cache/filter/index policies and reserve25%. Every successful cell requires complete right cache.

factors.name: order
factors.how: One fixed x/v/b round for seed202, preserving the original second-input arm order. Fresh cold process per arm; no measured small stratum rerun.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen Rust analyzer validates complete attempted rungs and labels, preserves failures, and plots all rows. No inferential timing analysis.

comparisons.threshold: All success certificates replay, corrupt scalars fail, and certificate bytes match across formulas/repeats.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Preserve original seed202 x/v/b order. Identical baseline surrounds candidate on the same host. No pooling with prior-host timings.

seed_derivation.note: Exactly202 for each arm; target-coordinate start1009*202 and unchanged solver seed.

instance_sampling.rule: Exact preceding63-bit curve and seed202 public-coordinate target. Original curves.txt hash64e5335d0a39eb574afb3072208ac6237425d484d17c69634e55c112fcf4d9c5; regenerated data checked byte-identically; ladder skips52-bit fixture.

blinding.how: Descriptive frontier accounting; no masked or inferential timing claim.

power.note: One fixed public target and one x/v/b round. Exact correctness and descriptive L0 timings only; no significance or population inference.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Prior affine seed202 complete recovery about1191s. Three arms estimated3573s plus fresh preflight. v1 charged180s and v2 charged8820s; remaining9000worker/9300controller seconds. Prior interrupted seed202 clock never used. Estimate only.

primary.name: Independently replayed recovery
primary.definition: One iff solver succeeded, fresh verifier replay passed and corrupted-scalar replay failed; otherwise zero. Public target scalar never generated.

secondary.name: Complete execution and audit
secondary.definition: Outer native clock from target-coordinate construction through solver startup/recovery/shutdown, independent replay, negative-control replay and certificate comparisons. Includes validation overhead.

secondary.name: Cold complete recovery
secondary.definition: Outer clock from target-coordinate construction through driver startup, curve validation, service startup, bases, relation collection, elimination, in-process certificate replay, serialization and process teardown. Additional independent replay excluded and recorded separately.

record: Stage clocks and outer complete execution clock
Bound failures and unattempted higher rungs
Row representation and conservative admission bytes; no measured peak VRAM claim
TABLE diagnostics require full cache and positive filter storage on every successful cell. Query visits include speculative scheduling work; no total measured field-operation count.

stopping_rules.rule: After full preflight, execute exactly63-bit seed202 arms x/v/b once on this host. No retry or additional inputs. Stop at9000worker/9300controller seconds including setup and cleanup. Preserve all failures/interruption; no mixed-host matched set.
Per solve7200s; fresh replay60s; fixture180s; worker9000/controller9300s. Preflight/sanitizer failure stops before measurements; preserve partial records.

invalidation_rules: Any wrong recovery, accepted corrupted scalar, certificate-byte mismatch, missing planned cell without declared stop, failed sanitizer or unexpected process error invalidates the run. Explicit timeout/limits are retained.

decision_rule.text: Report exact recoveries and counts, per-row cold and query clocks, candidate divided by mean(b,x), and abs(b-x)/mean(b,x) separately for each size/seed. No pooled inferential claim; L0 times are descriptive. No causal comparison to older panels.
decision_rule.threshold: Every reported recovery independently replayed; all three planned new cells accounted for.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact recoveries; descriptive per-input paired cold/oracle ratios, baseline repeat spread, median/minimum across available rounds
decision_rule.interval: Baseline repeat range per fixed input; not a confidence interval
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Per fixed size/seed candidate_seconds/mean(b,x); baseline AA relative spread abs(b-x)/mean(b,x). Ratios only when all three recoveries verify.

graphs: Every solver execution against field bits, including bounded failures

inadmissible: Claiming a largest possible ECDLP size from a finite timed ladder
Treating L0 times as certified speedups
Hiding unsuccessful trials or higher unattempted rungs
Claiming a tensor or subexponential backend from generic MITM
Supplying the target scalar to recovery

literature.claim: Previous complete recoveries define fixed workloads; stage diagnostic mixes specialization and instrumentation and is not a production speedup.
